main.description: A forum topic for one wiki, anchored to a Bluesky post. The topic's content lives as an app.bsky.feed.post thread on Bluesky (long posts are split into reply chains at paragraph boundaries); this record is the anchor that ties the thread to the wiki and is discovered through the .wikiRef backlink.

wikiRef.description: AT-URI of the wiki this topic belongs to.

rootPost.description: AT-URI of the first app.bsky.feed.post in the thread.

noteSlug.description: Optional article the discussion is about; the article's Discuss button links here.
